correctness.rationale: Four exhaustive and disjoint first-factor cases, rank 0/2/3/4; Cayley–Hamilton anticommutator identity; idempotent-projection/projective-eigenline incidence; exact q-power counts; 7 output classes and \(q^8\) mass. Direct independently constructed enumeration over F3 (6561 pairs) and F5 (390625 pairs) matches every target; independent F9 Gaussian elimination matches 22 selected targets, all 6561 first factors each. Characteristic 2 and higher matrix sizes expressly unproved.

value.rationale: A complete natural fiber invariant of the special Jordan product, rather than only existence or a single zero value, is determined for every target and every odd finite field. The five nonscalar fiber strata are distinguished by the intrinsic eigenline geometry of the target, with exact target population formulas and exceptional scalar concentration; this is a reproducible systematic classification with potential use in matrix-bilinear random models. The zero case and underlying Sylvester and Jordan-form ingredients are not represented as novel.
